description: This file defines SQLAlchemy ORM models for a career pathway navigator application, including classes for roles, skills, role-skill relationships, recommendations, progress tracking, and roadmaps.

classes.name: TimestampMixin
classes.description: Provides created_at and updated_at timestamp fields for models.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Represents a career role, such as Chief Architect or CTO.

classes.name: RoleSkill
classes.description: Associates roles with required skill levels, including gap annotations.

classes.name: Recommendation
classes.description: Provides actionable recommendations linked to role-skill requirements.

classes.name: Progress
classes.description: Tracks progress for a role/skill combination, intended for future user-specific extension.

classes.name: Roadmap
classes.description: Stores user-created roadmap graphs for career progression.
